# Trekov

> Trekov is an app for group rides. The whole group follows one route and sees each other live on one map, with one-tap STOP, WAIT and LET'S GO alerts, push-to-talk, turn-by-turn navigation and offline maps. Made in India. Website: https://trekov.com

## What it does

- Everyone on one map: every rider live, with position, heading and speed, and the whole route drawn under them.
- STOP, WAIT and LET'S GO alerts: one tap and every phone in the group flashes full screen, buzzes and sounds a loud alarm.
- Push-to-talk: hold the button to speak to the whole group. Nothing is sent unless the button is held, and nothing is recorded.
- Trip planning: build a trip from real places in riding order, with the distance and time between stops and the fuel, food, stays and tolls along the way.
- Host and captain: whoever creates the trip is the host, who adds and removes riders and names a captain for the group to follow.
- Open rides: a host can make a group trip public so other riders can find it and ask to join; the host approves each one.
- Navigation: turn-by-turn with the group still on the map, a screen that stays awake, and an off-route warning.
- Offline maps: download the route before leaving, and the map and position keep working without signal.
- Places: stays, food, fuel, garages, rentals and things to see near a rider or a route, with photos from riders who were there.

## Privacy

- A rider's live position goes only to the people on their trip and is never stored on Trekov's servers.
- Sharing can be switched off, or hidden from one rider while the rest still see it.

## Availability and price

- Android: download from https://trekov.com/download/ (Android 7 or newer). Google Play is coming.
- iPhone: open https://trekov.com/app/ in Safari, tap Share, then Add to Home Screen. The App Store version is coming.
- Laptop: https://trekov.com/app/ runs in the browser.
- Everything is free for everyone until 31 October 2026, with no card needed.
